prior_pilot_effect_check.EVO22: ZIP Range ABI pilot remains not promoted; Element v2 used full GET and v3/G293 used retained local bytes. No observed EVO22 effect on these results.
prior_pilot_effect_check.EVO23: Pre-freeze package crosscheck remains not promoted; Element expected and actual package were the same. No observed EVO23 effect on these results.

baseline: The v2 fixture accepted a minimal synthetic aapt2 package line, but its released parser used an unanchored name/version regex. The actual aapt2 line also carried platformBuildVersionName='15', which overwrote the parsed name and caused terminal manifest identity drift after a 72,422,482-byte GET taking 222.805 seconds. V3 corrected the parser and replayed the actual raw line; G279 and G293 illustrate successful receipt-bound handoffs but do not establish parser-contract coverage.
one_improvement: Before release of a one-shot command that parses external tool text, require a fixture for each acceptance-critical parser using a representative full output line with suffix/prefix name collisions, plus the minimal positive. Bind that fixture and parser script by SHA in the release receipt. A mismatch blocks release; this is a local preparation gate, not a substitute for runtime identity or signature checks.
prediction: On a future parser with v2-style unanchored fields, the expanded fixture fails before one-shot release while a correct parser accepts both minimal and collision-bearing lines; fixture execution stays below 1 second and causes no network or canonical mutation.
falsifier: A future exact output with field collisions passes the preparation fixture but fails the released parser, or the fixture rejects a valid output that the authoritative exact package/version/ABI parser should accept.

pilot.first_attempt_issue: Pilot path calculation used parents[5] instead of parents[4]; corrected within the pilot only before the measured run.

decision: Peer recommends one prospective candidate-level trial, with root decision pending. Do not promote to the 89-item flow from this retrospective replay.
